english.title: Attempt rape
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to rape a person

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and standard offence Wording is now OBSOLETE, it has been created specifically to cater historically for attempt rape offences prior to the Criminal Attempts Act 1981. For the current offences of attempt rape, see the following: Attempt rape of a boy under the age of 13
Attempt rape of a girl under the age of 13 Attempt to rape a boy aged 13 / 14 / 15Attempt to rape a girl aged 13 / 14 / 15 Attempt to rape a man aged 16 or overAttempt to rape a woman aged 16 or over

other.penalty:
Indictable only - Life imprisonment
